title: There’s a Fire on the Mountain (SASL)
description: Thuli and her friends love to play “There’s a Fire on the Mountain”. But then one day there is a real fire and all the beautiful plants on the mountain are turned to ash. Thuli and her friends are sad … until they see some tiny red and green shoots. What could they be?
subjects: Nature and looking after our planet
